registryCustodian: Lutsk City Council geoportal; State Land Cadastre services are also documented by the city administrative-service center.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Ukrainian discovery queries were performed. Both identified first-party Lutsk City Council geoportal evidence. The Ukrainian query additionally identified the city administrative service for State Land Cadastre parcel extracts.
requestOutcomes: The city dataset page and TMS access page returned 200 HTML. The documented carto raster tile covering the exact WUP point returned 200 image/png. The National Geoportal /api/geo/parcel coordinate request returned 403; a guessed /api/v2 path returned 404; the non-API route redirected to authorization. The legacy newmap host failed DNS. No authentication, token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or TLS exception was used.
schemaAndCrs: City map configuration lists EPSG:4326, EPSG:3395, EPSG:500002, and EPSG:600007; the TMS page states WGS 84 / Pseudo-Mercator. No parcel feature schema was returned.
nativeFieldMapping: Observed city-side metadata was dataset id 12376028776684568 and dataset title Земельні ділянки. No parcel-row field names or stable parcel identity were returned, so no GeoJSON sample is retained and no synthetic identity is assigned.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier only if source-proven
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [50.7507560557239, 25.3429472477178] was preserved in latitude/longitude order and not shifted.
The successful raster tile is evidence of map coverage, not a parcel-feature or citywide geometry result.
No exact-point miss was inferred because the local request returned a raster tile and the national API was access-restricted.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax/account, certificate, or title fields were requested or retained.
No retained GeoJSON sample is included because no safe native parcel identity and full polygon were observed.
Independent serial review is required before any adapter/runtime qualification.

qualification.reason: A local first-party cadastral dataset and public raster map route were verified, but no bounded anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response was obtained during this attempt; source admission is not justified.

uncertainty: The city portal may expose vector or feature services through UI routes not observed in this bounded request set. The national parcel API's access restriction and the absence of a returned feature schema limit qualification. This is recorded as unavailable evidence, not proof that Lutsk lacks cadastral records.
